summary.en: Amps, delay, tape tricks: the studio becomes part of the arrangement.
summary.zh: 扩音、延时、磁带手法：录音室成为编曲的一部分。

body.en: Psychedelic rock treats the studio as an instrument. Effects, tape collage, and longer forms open routes into Progressive Rock and experimental rock.
body.zh: 迷幻摇滚把录音室当作乐器。效果器、磁带拼贴与更长曲式，通向 Progressive Rock 与实验摇滚。
